} else {
    let x = lhs as int;
    let d = rhs as int;
    let output = if x == 0 {
        0
    } else if x > 0 && d > 0 {
        x / d
    } else if x < 0 && d < 0 {
        ((x * -1) / (d * -1))
    } else if x < 0 {
        ((x * -1) / d) * -1
    } else {
        (x / (d * -1)) * -1
    };
    if output < <i8>::MIN || output > <i8>::MAX { None } else { Some(output as i8) }
}),

    }
